verdict.rationale: Brex documents real-time spend tracking: the product page says it will "track spend instantly," and it claims to manage spend "in real time." Pending card transaction events also arrive via real-time webhooks, so spend shows up when it happens rather than at statement time. However, no evidence shows dashboard views that break spend down by team, category and merchant; departments and department budgets exist, but no such slicing is documented. missing for 10: documented spend breakdowns by team/category/merchant, a founder-facing real-time spend dashboard description, independent or hands-on corroboration of same-day visibility

support.subject: As a founder, I can see company spend in real time — by team, category, and merchant — the day it happens, not when statements land

citations.quote: Assign top-line budgets, and track spend instantly
Manage global spend and close the books in real time
Brex APIs offer webhooks to notify you in real-time when certain events happen in your account.
Subscribe to receive pending transaction events for expenses made on Brex Card
Manage budgets and spend limits in over 100 currencies and embed localized expense policies to enable spend for entities, individuals, and departments.
